expected.exit_semantics: DESIGN_PLACEHOLDER; the real exit code must be frozen from the runner ABI; refusal means non-success + typed token + zero effect
expected.predicate: at least two different alternatives each with evidence, counterevidence, cost/risk (UNKNOWN allowed), ChangeCone, expected raw, owner and rollback; no fixed template
raw_assertions: stdout/stderr bytes and SHA recorded separately
pre/post world or file state recorded
observed is null until a real run

not_covered: no real Finding/raw exists; this is a design contract only
freeze_rule: expected-before-observed; Case Owner re-freezes real bytes; old FAIL is preserved; oracle changes require a CR and a new case revision
